notes: Select All comes to All Applications: one tap shields the whole list at once — the smart way to baseline a brand-new phone. A known-bad app can never be shielded, and already-shielded apps are left exactly as they were. The front buttons also get breathing room: SCAN, How it works, Check for updates and Settings are spaced out. Nothing else moves: same verdicts, same colors, same threat list. Tap Check for updates to get it.
